name: @vaibanbuilds/releaselint
description: Release readiness linter for GitHub projects.

scripts.check:passing: node src/cli.js check --fixture fixtures/passing-release.json --version-file fixtures/package-v1.2.1.json --format markdown --no-fail
scripts.check:pyproject: node src/cli.js check --fixture fixtures/passing-release.json --version-file fixtures/pyproject.toml --format markdown --no-fail
scripts.check:cargo: node src/cli.js check --fixture fixtures/passing-release.json --version-file fixtures/Cargo.toml --format markdown --no-fail
scripts.check:annotations: node src/cli.js check --fixture fixtures/sample-release.json --format markdown --annotations always --no-fail
scripts.check:commits: node src/cli.js check --config fixtures/releaselint-config.conventional.json --fixture fixtures/conventional-commits.valid.json --version-file fixtures/package-v1.3.0.json --format markdown --no-fail && ! node src/cli.js check --config fixtures/releaselint-config.conventional.json --fixture fixtures/conventional-commits.invalid.json --format markdown
scripts.check:init: tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) && node src/cli.js init --config "$tmpdir/.releaselint.json" && ! node src/cli.js init --config "$tmpdir/.releaselint.json" && node src/cli.js init --config "$tmpdir/.releaselint.json" --force && node src/cli.js init --print >"$tmpdir/printed.json" && node -e 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8")); JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[2], "utf8"));' "$tmpdir/.releaselint.json" "$tmpdir/printed.json"
scripts.check:config: node src/cli.js config validate --config fixtures/releaselint-config.valid.json && ! node src/cli.js config validate --config fixtures/releaselint-config.invalid.json
